You will serve as a key technical liaison for our process manufacturing ecosystem supporting desktop users while maintaining real-time integration between industrial plant systems, laboratory testing systems, and SAP Business One , specifically leveraging BCMIX (batch control/mixing) and LABMIX (laboratory/quality assurance) add-ons. Key Responsibilities 1. Enterprise Desktop & End-User Support Provide 1st Level support for Windows workstations, peripherals, and enterprise applications across office and remote users. Administer endpoint management systems for automated software deployment, patch management, and Group Policy (GPO) enforcement. Manage identity services, access control, and authentication via Active Directory (AD) Support specialized workplace peripherals, including PCs, tablets, phones, scanners, printers, industrial scales, and serial communication interfaces & devices 2. Industrial IT & Shop-Floor Integration Support Support, deploy, and maintain ruggedized industrial PCs, HMIs, touch-screen terminals, and batch-control workstations across the plant floor. Maintain operational uptime and real-time data flows between shop-floor batch dosing systems ( BCMIX ), quality testing instruments ( LABMIX ), and SAP Business One Troubleshoot data interfaces, online & offline backups, integration framework queues, and server connections linking physical plant machinery to enterprise applications. Ensure operational continuity of laboratory instrumentation feeding quality control metrics into LABMIX . 3. Network Infrastructure & Security Diagnose and resolve complex network connectivity issues across LAN, industrial Wi-Fi, VPN, and VLAN-segmented plant environments. Support enterprise and industrial managed networking equipment (e.g., Access Points, switches, firewalls, and routers) within the corporate Network Model. Troubleshoot end-to-end network protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP) as well as industrial protocols (Modbus TCP, Ether Net/IP, PROFINET, OPC UA). Enforce cybersecurity best practices, network isolation/DMZ rules, endpoint threat protection, and disaster recovery image backups for plant-critical workstations. Required Qualifications & Skills Experience: 5+ years of combined experience in IT system administration/desktop support alongside exposure to manufacturing, industrial OT, or plant environments. ERP & Industry Add-Ons: Hands-on experience supporting SAP Business One clients and process industry add-ons like BCMIX (batch mixing/recipe management) and LABMIX (laboratory information & QC). Network Infrastructure: Solid understanding of TCP/IP, VLAN segmentation, NAT, VPN tunnels, and diagnosing connectivity via packet capture/network tools (Wireshark, ping, traceroute, nslookup). OS & Directory Services: Deep proficiency in Windows 10/11, Windows Server and Active Directory, GPO Industrial Readiness: Ability and willingness to operate safely in plant floor environments (adhering to PPE guidelines, managing physical safety, and minimizing production downtime). Preferred Qualifications Bachelors in IT / Computer Sciences Certifications such as CompTIA Network+, CCNA / CCNA Industrial will be plus Experience with industrial protocols (Modbus TCP, EtherNet/IP, OPC UA) and SCADA/PLC interfacing. Familiarity with industrial cybersecurity standards (IEC 62443, NIST SP 800-82). UAE Driving license is mandatory.

This role is responsible for diagnosing technical issues, resolving user requests, and ensuring the reliable operation of information technology systems. The position requires strong troubleshooting skills, effective communication, and the ability to deliver timely technical assistance while maintaining high standards of customer service. Key Responsibilities • Provide remote technical support for hardware, software, operating systems, and business applications. • Diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve technical issues through remote access tools and support platforms. • Install, configure, and maintain software, system updates, and user applications. • Respond to service requests, prioritize incidents, and manage support tickets through completion. • Assist users with account access, system configuration, and general technology-related inquiries. • Monitor system performance and identify recurring technical issues for further investigation. • Escalate complex incidents to specialized technical teams when appropriate while maintaining clear communication with users. • Maintain accurate documentation of support activities, resolutions, and technical procedures. • Support security practices by following established policies for system access, software updates, and data protection. • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives by recommending enhancements to support processes and technical documentation. Summary The Remote IT Technician plays a vital role in maintaining reliable technology operations by delivering efficient remote technical support and resolving user issues with professionalism and accuracy. This position offers opportunities to expand technical expertise, contribute to operational efficiency, and build a rewarding career in information technology and technical support.

Experience with motion graphics and basic graphics to create titles, lower thirds, infographics, and visual overlays aligned with brand guidelines. Hands-on experience with industry-standard editing tools (e.g., Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro) and graphics software (e.g., After Effects, Illustrator, or similar). Strong storytelling sense, especially for social impact, humanitarian, or documentary content, with attention to ethical and respectful representation. Excellent collaboration and communication skills, including the ability to receive and implement feedback from diverse stakeholders. Ability to manage multiple projects, meet deadlines, and work effectively in a hybrid environment combining on-site and remote work. Familiarity with AI, technology for development, or international development contexts is an advantage.
